name: npc_fb_new_sources_2026_09
description: New sources from a 2026-09-24 newspapers.com search batch (first-ever Nadeau queries; City Aikido, Aikido of Marin, Ikeda-Pittsburgh, Ikeda 8th dan [0 hits — no corroboration of Jones claim], Strozzi-Heckler, Quantum Aikido, Aikido of Mountain View) plus public Facebook posts found via web search (FB Graph API unavailable — no FB_ACCESS_TOKEN). Highlights: May 1978 'Festival of the Happy Martial Arts' at Stanford Frost Amphitheater billing Nadeau as 'Spiritual teacher and Director of Northern California Aikido' alongside Saotome/Doran/Leonard/Palmer/Huang; earliest Nadeau newspaper mention (San Mateo Times, Jan 1 1968); Whole Earth Review column (SF Chronicle Jul 20 1988) reviewing Strozzi-Heckler's 'Aikido and the New Warrior'; Wendy Palmer obituary via AikiWeb FB post; Moon at Riviera Seminar Montreux Jun 2025 via Dojo Kashin Roma FB video post.

metadata.claim_text: May 1978 newspaper ads (SF Chronicle, SF Examiner, Peninsula Times Tribune) for 'A Festival of the Happy Martial Arts' at Frost Amphitheater describe Robert Nadeau as 'Spiritual teacher and Director of Northern California Aikido'. Documentary evidence of his organizational role in Northern California aikido by 1978.
